details.question: 2025年1季度GMV同比2024年
details.pred_sql:
SELECT
  dd.quarter AS 季度,
  SUM(CASE WHEN dd.date_id >= 20250101 AND dd.date_id <= 20250331 THEN fo.order_amount ELSE 0 END) AS 2025年Q1_GMV,
  SUM(CASE WHEN dd.date_id >= 20240101 AND dd.date_id <= 20240331 THEN fo.order_amount ELSE 0 END) AS 2024年Q1_GMV,
  (SUM(CASE WHEN dd.date_id >= 20250101 AND dd.date_id <= 20250331 THEN fo.order_amount ELSE 0 END)
   - SUM(CASE WHEN dd.date_id >= 20240101 AND dd.date_id <= 20240331 THEN fo.order_amount ELSE 0 END)) AS GMV同比增量,
  CASE
    WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN dd.date_id >= 20240101 AND dd.date_id <= 20240331 THEN fo.order_amount ELSE 0 END) = 0 THEN NULL
    ELSE (SUM(CASE WHEN dd.date_id >= 20250101 AND dd.date_id <= 20250331 THEN fo.order_amount ELSE 0 END)
          - SUM(CASE WHEN dd.date_id >= 20240101 AND dd.date_id <= 20240331 THEN fo.order_amount ELSE 0 END))
         / SUM(CASE WHEN dd.date_id >= 20240101 AND dd.date_id <= 20240331 THEN fo.order_amount ELSE 0 END)
  END AS GMV同比增长率
FROM fact_order fo
JOIN dim_date dd ON fo.date_id = dd.date_id
WHERE dd.quarter = 'Q1'
  AND ((dd.date_id >= 20240101 AND dd.date_id <= 20240331)
    OR (dd.date_id >= 20250101 AND dd.date_id <= 20250331))
GROUP BY dd.quarter;
